name: Pedram Minoofar
tagline: Top rated Real Estate attorney in Los Angeles, California
about: A partner at the Los Angeles, California, law firm of Yadegar Minoofar & Soleymani LLP, attorney Pedram Minoofar brings extensive experience representing developers, owners, contractors, subcontractors and material suppliers in both public and private sectors in cases that involve all facets of complex real estate and construction litigation. Rather than only relying on traditional trial procedures, he defends his clients’ rights through mediation, arbitration and other alternative dispute resolution methods.

Honest, level-headed and helpful, Mr. Minoofar offers sound legal advice with clients’ welfare at the forefront. In addition to counseling clients on dissolutions of corporations, partnerships and limited liability companies, he provides invaluable guidance on real estate transactions, including private developments, contract negotiations, leasing, insurance, indemnity and other general matters.

Before obtaining his Juris Doctor degree from Loyola Law School in 1998, Mr. Minoofar completed his bachelor’s degree in economics, magna cum laude, in 1995 at the University of California. He maintains his professional connections through legal organizations and establishments such as The State Bar of California, the Los Angeles County Bar Association and the Beverly Hills Bar Association. He lectures on various construction and real estate topics at conferences and seminars.

Throughout his over 20-year legal career, he has counseled clients on disputes exceeding $100 million in the development of hospitals, medical research facilities, wastewater treatment facilities, schools, apartments, condominiums, and other public and private developments worth over $500 million. Mr. Minoofar holds a “Very Good” rating on Avvo and has received recognition with other honors and accolades as well.
